full_prompt_en: A square illustrated magazine cover shows a group of diners around a small table beneath a dense arch of blue-green foliage, with a glowing pale building centered in the distance. At the top, cream serif lettering reads "THE NEW YORKER," with the smaller word "THE" above the larger title. Dark tree trunks rise from both sides and curve overhead, nearly enclosing the upper half of the selected cover. Leaves and flower heads overlap the title at its edges without hiding the main letters. Through the opening between the trees, a tall cream-colored building with many lit windows stands against a yellow-green sky. Along the lower third, five people sit close together at a table, their faces warmed by reflected light. The person on the far left leans inward holding a glass; a bald figure beside him looks down toward the tabletop. Near the center, a light-haired woman turns toward a dark-haired woman, while an older gray-haired man at far right rests his head on one hand. Bottles, glasses, pale dishes, and small bright floral shapes crowd the table and foreground. The figures are drawn with gently exaggerated faces and loose painterly contours, while the foliage forms a darker, more textured frame. Light appears to come from the building opening and the table area, illuminating faces, glass rims, and small flowers against the surrounding teal shadow. The overall composition nests an intimate social group inside a broad leafy arch, balancing dark ornament, warm cream architecture, and restrained magazine typography.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形插画杂志封面呈现一群食客围坐在蓝绿色密叶拱廊下的小桌旁，远处中央有一栋发光的浅色建筑。顶部乳白色衬线字写着“THE NEW YORKER”，较小的“THE”位于较大的刊名上方。深色树干从两侧升起并在上方弯曲，几乎围住所选封面的上半部。树叶和花头在标题边缘与之交叠，却没有遮住主要字母。树间开口里，一栋拥有许多亮窗的高大乳白建筑立在黄绿色天空前。下部三分之一处，五个人紧挨着坐在餐桌旁，脸被反射的暖光照亮。最左边的人向内倾身，手中拿着杯子；旁边的秃发人物低头望向桌面。中央附近，一名浅发女子转向黑发女子，最右侧的灰发年长男子用一只手支着头。瓶子、杯子、浅色餐具和细小的亮色花形挤满桌面与前景。人物的脸略有夸张，以松散绘画轮廓描出，枝叶则形成更暗、更有肌理的边框。光似乎来自建筑所在的开口和桌面区域，使脸、杯沿和小花在周围青绿色阴影中发亮。整体构图把亲密的社交小群体安放在宽阔的枝叶拱廊内，平衡深色装饰、暖乳白建筑和克制的杂志字样。
style_prompt_en: Editorial illustration combines elegant serif typography with painterly figurative detail and a dense ornamental border. Deep teal, blue-green, and nearly black masses frame a concentrated center of cream, pale gold, and small warm highlights. Curved foliage-like forms overlap and interlock, making a tunnel of shadow around a luminous opening. Faces and small objects are modeled with economical softened strokes, while the border retains scratchier texture and more intricate marks. Letterforms remain clear within the upper negative space, integrated into the picture rather than isolated in a box. Warm light is concentrated in the central opening and a narrow lower band, drawing the eye through the dark enclosure. The overall effect is urbane, intimate, and richly atmospheric.
style_prompt_zh: 编辑插画把优雅的衬线排字与绘画式具象细节、密集的装饰边框结合起来。深青、蓝绿与近黑色大形体围住由乳白、浅金及少量暖色高光构成的集中核心。弯曲的枝叶状形体互相遮叠、嵌合，在明亮开口周围形成阴影隧道。面部和小物件用经济而柔和的笔触塑形，边框则保留更粗涩的肌理和繁密笔痕。字形在上方负空间内保持清楚，并融入画面，而不是被单独放进方框。暖光集中于中央开口和下方窄带，引导视线穿过深色围合。整体效果精致、亲密且充满浓厚的空气感。
theme_en: A magazine cover of diners beneath a leafy arch with a glowing building beyond
theme_zh: 一幅杂志封面：食客坐在繁叶拱廊下，远处建筑发光
name: The New Yorker magazine
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
